# environment

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/pkg/controller/observers/environment"
```

Package environment re\-exports the environment\-observer reconciler type as a public alias. The reconciler itself stays in internal/controller/observers/environment, unchanged; this package exists only so that external test modules have a valid, non\-internal import path to construct it against.

<a name="Reconciler"></a>
## type Reconciler

Reconciler fans in readiness from all composed CR types and aggregates them into the owning Environment's status.

```go
type Reconciler = internalenvironment.Reconciler
```
